verdict.rationale: GitBook documents its own background AI behaviors: GitBook Agent flags and drafts fixes for outdated or missing content, and auto translations keep localized docs current with minimal manual effort. That points to some autonomous background work. However, nothing shows user-configurable automations, triggers, or recurring schedules. missing for 10: user-defined automation setup, documented triggers/schedules, evidence that agent actions run fully unattended rather than as drafts for review, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The docs platform that flags outdated content. Then fixes it.
GitBook’s AI documentation agent identifies missing or outdated content, drafts improvements, and helps your team keep product knowledge aligned with real user needs
Auto translations make it easy to keep your documentation up-to-date in multiple languages, with minimal manual effort.
